method: Lighthouse 12.x lab runs, one run per row. Noise is roughly +/-3 performance points and +/-300 ms LCP; single runs, not medians. Mobile = Moto G Power emulation with Slow 4G and 4x CPU (simulated throttling). Desktop = 1350x940, 40 ms RTT. Headless Chromium in a sandbox with software rasterisation, so absolute paint timings are pessimistic. Signed-in runs use a profile seeded with the bearer token (prof-student, prof-teacher, prof-learner, prof-admin). Cold runs clear the HTTP cache, code cache, service worker and Cache Storage first.
